content_zh:
这时我无意中看了二蛋的脚腕一眼，发现竟然有一片淤青，形状就好像被人用手抓过一样，想来，这肯定就是那个小女孩抓他时留下的指印了。
老头见二蛋没什么大碍，眼睛瞥了几眼水塘，板着脸对我们说：“你们几娃娃个你们几个给活吞了。”
铁柱他们一听吓得跳起来老高，都说怪不得二蛋竟往水里沉呢，原来是水底下有大鱼作怪啊。
我心说，这老头分明是在撒谎呢，明明水底是一个小女鬼，怎么到他嘴里就成了一条大鱼了呢？
我正想跟老头解释我看到的一切，没成想，他看到我们村的田寡妇正好胳膊挽着筐子，大P股一扭一扭的从岸上路过。
老头顿时双眼放光，就像饿狼遇到小绵羊似得，甚至连锄头都顾不上拿，迈开步子就追了上去。
这老头怎么说也是60多岁的人了，没成想跑得比兔子还快，几步之下就与田寡妇拉近了距离，他一边追着，嘴里还哼着一首不知名的小曲。
紧打鼓来慢打锣喽，停锣住鼓听唱歌吆。
伸手摸姐面边丝吆，乌云飞了半天边儿。
伸手摸姐脑前边呀，天庭饱满兮瘾人来。
伸手摸姐冒毛湾吆，分散外面冒中宽呀。
伸手摸姐下各尖嘿，下各尖匕在胸前那。
伸手摸妹屁.股边呀，好似扬扬大白绵来…………
说真的，别看老头长得其貌不扬，唱的小曲还挺好听儿，不过就是感觉不太雅致，歌词还有腔调，怎么听，都有点像黄段子。
那田寡妇见老头追了上来，又听到那羞人的小曲，气呼呼的回过头，红着脸对老头啐了一句:“老色鬼！臭不要脸的，别跟着俺！”说完，大P.股一扭三晃荡，脚步更急促了。
“哎呀，大P.股！慢走，哎呀，不是…田妹妹慢走，让哥哥我来帮你提筐子吧。”老头对于田寡妇的笑骂也不在意，嘴里嘻嘻哈哈的笑着，一脸猥琐之态的尾随田寡妇逐渐远去。
最后小湾子就剩下我们几个，你看看我，我看看你，大眼瞪小眼，谁也不敢在水塘边玩了，纷纷收起了渔网，各自散伙回家了。
而回去的一路上，我与铁柱二蛋他们打打闹闹，稀里糊涂的也就把看到女婴的事儿给忘到脑后了，回到家里这件事也没对我爸妈提起过。
我原本以为这件事这就样过去了，没成想，当天晚我又发烧了，而且比之前烧的还要严重，这一次，甚至险些要了我的小命。
我发烧的时间是在晚上10点左右，当时我们一家三口还没睡，坐在炕上有说有笑的唠着闲嗑，冷不丁的，我突然感觉眼前白光一闪，紧接着脑袋天旋地转一般，便一头栽倒在炕上不省人事了。

这下可把我爸吓了一跳，扶起我摸了摸.我的额头，发现滚烫不已，他以为我又发烧了，顿时吃了一惊。
有了上次的经验，他二话没说，跳下地，急匆匆的，踏着夜色就跑去王婆子家求灵符去了，剩下我妈一人，抱起我搂在怀里，摸着我的额头干着急。
十多分钟过去，我爸把灵符求了回来，烧成灰放进碗里，倒上水，因为我昏迷醒，硬是撬开我的嘴灌了下去，完事之后他二人便守在我身旁，瞪大了眼睛望着我，等着我退烧醒过来。
过了一会，我爸摸了摸.我额头，发现烧是退下去了，不过奇怪的是，我的身体突然间变得异常冰冷，并且连呼吸都开始变得极其微弱，毫不夸张地说，那时的我用气若游丝形容最为贴切了。
只见我这时双眼紧闭，面色暗黄，手脚发僵，任凭我爸妈在怎么呼喊也没转醒，用他们的话说，我当时除了能够呼吸意外，跟死人没什么两样。
“喜儿吆，你可别吓娘喂，你这到底是咋滴了。”我妈死死的抱着我，见我半死不活的模样，可把她给吓坏了，她说话连牙齿都打颤了，她抬起头，语气急促的对我爸说：“国华，你看喜儿这是咋回事啊，王婆子的灵符不顶用了啊，喝完灵符不但没好咋还变严重了，要不你还是把王婆子请来，让她亲自给瞧瞧吧。”

content_en:
At this time, I accidentally glanced at Erdan's ankle and found that there was a bruise, which looked like someone had scratched it. Thinking about it, this must be the fingerprint left by the little girl when she grabbed him.
Seeing that Erdan was fine, the old man glanced at the pond a few times and said to us with a straight face: "You guys are going to be eaten alive."
Tie Zhu and the others were so frightened that they jumped up and Lao Gao said, "No wonder Erdan sank into the water. It turned out that there was a big fish under the water causing trouble."
I thought to myself, this old man is obviously lying. There is obviously a little female ghost at the bottom of the water, but how come it turned into a big fish when it came into his mouth?
I was about to explain everything I saw to the old man, but unexpectedly, he saw Widow Tian from our village holding a basket on her arm and twirling her big butt as she passed by the shore.
The old man's eyes suddenly lit up, like a hungry wolf encountering a little sheep. He didn't even bother to pick up the hoe, and took a step forward to catch up.
After all, this old man was in his 60s. Unexpectedly, he ran faster than a rabbit. In a few steps, he closed the distance with Widow Tian. He chased her while humming an unknown ditty.
Play the drum hard and then play the gong slowly. Stop playing the gong and stop the drum to listen to the singing.
I stretched out my hand to touch my sister's face, and the dark clouds flew across the sky for a long time.
Reach out and touch the front of my sister's head. The heaven is full and addictive.
Reach out and touch my sister's Maomao Bay. It's spread out and Mao Zhong is wide.
He stretched out his hand to touch the lower tip of his sister's dagger. The lower tip of the dagger was on her chest.
He stretched out his hand to touch the girl's buttocks. It felt like a big white cotton pad...
To be honest, despite the old man's unattractive appearance, the ditty he sang was quite nice, but it just didn't feel elegant. The lyrics and the tone sounded a bit like a dirty joke no matter how you listened to it.
Seeing the old man chasing after her, and hearing the shameful ditty again, Widow Natian turned around angrily, blushed and spat at the old man: "Old pervert! You're such a shameless person, don't follow me!" After saying that, her big buttocks swayed, and her pace became even faster.
"Oh, big butt! Walk slowly, oh, no...Sister Tian, ​​walk slowly, let me help you carry the basket." The old man didn't care about Widow Tian's laughter and scolding, and followed Widow Tian away with a cheerful smile.
In the end, there were only a few of us left in the small bay. You looked at me and I looked at you. No one dared to play by the pond anymore. We all put away our fishing nets and dispersed to go home.
On the way back, I was fooling around with Tiezhu Erdan and the others, so I forgot about seeing the baby girl, and I never mentioned it to my parents when I got home.
I originally thought that this matter would just go away, but unexpectedly, I had a fever again that night, and it was worse than before. This time, it almost killed me.
The time when I had a fever was around 10 o'clock in the evening. The three of us were still awake at that time. We were sitting on the kang, chatting and laughing. Suddenly, I felt a flash of white light in front of my eyes, and then my head was spinning. Then I fell down on the kang and fell unconscious.
This shocked my dad. He lifted me up and touched my forehead. He found that my forehead was extremely hot. He thought I had a fever again and was surprised.
With the last experience in mind, he jumped off the ground without saying a word, and hurriedly ran to Mrs. Wang's house in the night to ask for the magic talisman. My mother was left alone, picking me up and holding me in her arms, touching my forehead in worry.
More than ten minutes later, my dad got the magic talisman back, burned it to ashes, put it in a bowl, and poured water on it. Because I was unconscious, he pried open my mouth and drank it. After that, he and I stayed by my side, looking at me with wide eyes, waiting for me to wake up from the fever.
After a while, my dad touched my forehead and found that the fever had subsided, but strangely, my body suddenly became extremely cold, and even my breathing began to become extremely weak., it is no exaggeration to say that the most appropriate description of my energy at that time was like a gossamer.
My eyes were tightly closed, my complexion was dark yellow, and my hands and feet were stiff. No matter how much my parents shouted, I didn't wake up. In their words, except that I could breathe, I was no different from a dead person.
"Xi'er, please don't scare me. What's wrong with you?" My mother hugged me tightly. Seeing my half-dead state, she was frightened. Her teeth chattered as she spoke. She raised her head and spoke in a rapid tone. He said to my dad: "Guohua, look what's going on with Xi'er. Mrs. Wang's magic talisman is no longer useful. After drinking the talisman, she not only didn't feel better but also got worse. Why don't you invite Mrs. Wang here and let her see for herself."
